verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs describe several in-product AI insight features. AI Chat answers questions across meetings and connected apps, meeting summaries are customizable and extract actionable insights by role, real-time coaching prompts draw on conversation history, and teams can monitor sentiment and keywords. One community report describes an inaccurate AI-generated outline, which is a quality complaint rather than evidence the capability is absent. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight and suggestion quality, and evidence that addresses the reported inaccuracy of generated outlines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions and help you create follow-ups, reports, and content.
Otter's fully customizable, AI-powered meeting summaries automatically extract actionable insights based on meeting purpose and for different functional roles
Get real-time, personalized coaching and prompts during calls based on your entire conversation history, company playbooks, and what's being discussed.
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
Monitor sentiment, engagement, and strategic keywords across customer-facing teams to align messaging and positioning.
